message.content:
Based on my research, I'll present you with a well-paced **7-day China itinerary** that balances iconic sights with comfortable travel. The most recommended route for first-timers is the **"Golden Triangle"** (Beijing → Xi'an → Shanghai) connected by high-speed rail, though I'll also include an alternative East China option.

---

## **Option 1: Classic Golden Triangle (Recommended for First-Timers)**

### **Days 1–3: Beijing — Imperial Heart**

**Day 1: Arrival & First Impressions**
- Land at Beijing Capital (PEK) or Daxing (PKX)
- Check into hotel near Dongcheng or Xicheng district
- Light afternoon walk through **hutongs** (traditional alleyways) like **Nanluoguxiang**
- Evening: Street food at **Wangfujing** or **Qianmen**

**Day 2: Forbidden City & Panoramic Views**
- Morning: **Forbidden City** (book tickets online 7 days ahead at 20:00 Beijing time)
- Afternoon: **Jingshan Park** for panoramic views over the palace roofs
- Evening: Peking duck dinner

**Day 3: Great Wall**
- Full morning at **Mutianyu** section (less crowded than Badaling) — book a tour or bus
- Return early afternoon; rest or visit **Temple of Heaven**
- Evening: Pack for tomorrow's train; confirm G-train booking

### **Day 4: Beijing → Xi'an**
- Morning: High-speed train from **Beijing South** to **Xi'an North** (~4.5–5.5 hours)
- Afternoon: Arrive Xi'an, check in near city center
- Evening: **Muslim Quarter** for street food — try **Rou Jia Mo** (Chinese hamburger) and **Biang Biang noodles**

### **Day 5: Xi'an — Ancient Wonders**
- Morning: **Terracotta Army** (half-day trip from city)
- Afternoon: **Giant Wild Goose Pagoda**
- Evening: Stroll **Great Tang All Day Mall** for lights and atmosphere

### **Day 6: Xi'an → Shanghai**
- Morning: Bike or walk atop **Xi'an City Wall** (~90 minute loop)
- Afternoon: High-speed train or flight to **Shanghai**
- Evening: **The Bund** at dusk for the iconic skyline view

### **Day 7: Shanghai — Modern Marvels & Departure**
- Morning: **Yu Garden** and Old City bazaar, or **Shanghai Museum**
- Afternoon: **French Concession** walk on **Wukang Road**
- Depart from **Pudong (PVG)** or **Hongqiao (SHA)** — allow 3+ hours for international flights

---

## **Option 2: East China Relaxed Route (Shanghai + Suzhou + Hangzhou)**

If you prefer gardens, canals, and lake scenery with easier logistics:

| Days | Location | Highlights |
|------|----------|------------|
| 1–3 | **Shanghai** | The Bund, Yu Garden, French Concession, metro exploration |
| 4 | **Suzhou** (day trip or overnight) | Classical gardens, Pingjiang Road canals |
| 5–7 | **Hangzhou** | West Lake, tea villages, Lingyin Temple |

All connected by trains under 1 hour. No airport hassles after arrival.

---

## **Essential Booking Checklist**

| When | What |
|------|------|
| 2+ weeks before | Book G-train tickets (release 15 days ahead, China time) |
| 7 days before | Forbidden City tickets drop at 20:00 Beijing time |
| Before departure | Install **WeChat**, **Alipay**, **DiDi**; arrange VPN if needed |
| Upon arrival | Get local SIM/eSIM for data |

## **Visa Note (2026)**
Many nationalities qualify for **240-hour visa-free transit** or **30-day unilateral visa-free** entry. Confirm based on your passport before booking non-refundable flights.

---

## **Estimated Budget**
- **Golden Triangle**: ¥7,500–10,000 (~$1,080–1,435 USD) per person
- **East China**: Similar range, slightly lower without flights between cities

---

Sources:
1. https://startchinatravel.com/7-day-china-itinerary-first-timers-2026/
2. https://hellochinatrip.com/7-days-in-chinathe-perfect-itinerary-for-first-timers-2026/
3. https://www.wetrip.global/faq/china-7-day-itinerary-best
4. https://wonderplan.ai/itineraries/china/7-days
5. https://pack-lightly.com/china/itinerary-7-days/
6. https://plantrip.io/itinerary/1060293
7. https://www.explorewithshanghai.com/hub-east-china-itinerary-7-days/
